description: Framework layer for rag-pipeline-py — ships the ingest + retrieve + answer pipeline (src/pipeline.py) and an AGENTS.md guide for AI-agent consumption.

buildHints.whenToUse: Apply to any rag-pipeline-py starter to get the full ingest → chunk → embed → Chroma → retrieve → LLM pipeline in a single src/pipeline.py file.
firstSteps: pip install -e . — installs langchain-core, langchain-text-splitters, chromadb, sentence-transformers, httpx, and python-dotenv
cp .env.example .env — then set LLM_BASE_URL to a running Ollama server (ollama serve) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
python -m src.pipeline index — builds the Chroma collection from docs/
python -m src.pipeline ask 'your question here' — retrieves and answers
gotchas: Changing EMBEDDING_MODEL invalidates the Chroma collection — delete VECTOR_DB_DIR and re-run index.
Ollama must be running before ask — start with `ollama serve` and pull the model with `ollama pull llama3.1:8b`.
PDF ingest requires `pip install pypdf` (or `pip install -e .[pdf]`) — not included in the base install.
The collection is rebuilt from scratch on every index run — intentional to avoid stale chunks.
architectureNotes: pipeline.py is the single entrypoint: index() chunks and embeds all docs into Chroma; ask() embeds the query, retrieves top-k chunks, and calls the LLM with a grounded system prompt.
All tuneable parameters (chunk size, top-k, model names, paths) are read from environment variables — override in .env without touching code.
LLM routing is auto-detected: URLs containing :11434 or ending in /api use Ollama's /api/chat; all others use OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions.

commands: python -m src.pipeline ask 'what is paged attention?'
